note: The vendored kernel is a pinned upstream checkout and is never edited. This lock is what makes that auditable: verify-baseline.mjs refuses when the checkout is dirty or its HEAD is not this commit.

built.note: Built artifacts are what the application loads and are gitignored, so git cannot report a local edit to them. This digest is the guard: recompute it with --record only when a rebuild is intended, and review the diff.
